text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Accompanying rookie trainer unfamiliar with VR space,
arrived at practice grounds where Byerley Turk was.

text_block_list.name: Rookie Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
Students running so desperately...
If it were me, I'd end up comforting
or cheering them on.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Watching horse girls lap track
with ragged breaths, Byerley Turk
merely watches in silence.

text_block_list.name: Rookie Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
...Um, Byerley Turk-san.
How much longer do you plan to run them?
Students look exhausted.

text_block_list.name: Byerley Turk
text_block_list.text:
...
Until I say so.

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa... gh!

text_block_list.name: Rookie Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
...Ugh.
Byerley Turk-san,
better let them rest soon—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Unable to watch any longer, rookie trainer pleads...
Yet Byerley Turk pays no mind.

text_block_list.name: Byerley Turk
text_block_list.text:
Fix posture!
You have at least 3 more laps in you!

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text:
...!
Yes ma'am!

text_block_list.name: Rookie Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
She could still run that much?!
Her form broke down, lap pace
was dropping too, and yet...
choice_data_list: Single word from Byerley-san raised morale.
Single word from Byerley-san raised morale, huh.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Byerley Turk accurately assesses
stamina limits of each horse girl.

text_block_list.name: Byerley Turk
text_block_list.text:
—Halt.
Authorized to rest!

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text:
Haa, haa...
S-So tired~!

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl B
text_block_list.text:
Reeeaaally tired, but...
Feel like I broke through own limits...!

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl C
text_block_list.text:
Me too, me too!
Felt like ran giving most power ever...!

text_block_list.name: Rookie Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
...Everyone's exhausted,
yet smiling brightly.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Entrusting limit assessment to Byerley Turk allowed
them to finish run without giving up, no matter how tough—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Looking at students with faces showing
they gave everything, can't help but agree.
choice_data_list: Rest timing was spot on too.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Admiring efficient training
possible only through support AI...

text_block_list.name: Rookie Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
Um... Byerley Turk-san.
I'm sorry for butting in
without understanding anything.

text_block_list.name: Byerley Turk
text_block_list.text:
...
As instructor guiding horse girls,
your judgment was soft.

text_block_list.name: Byerley Turk
text_block_list.text:
However, action born from caring for horse girls.
Apology unnecessary.

text_block_list.name: Rookie Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
...!
I will study harder
to become instructor like Byerley Turk-san!

text_block_list.name: Byerley Turk
text_block_list.text: As AI, perfectly natural judgment.

text_block_list.name: Byerley Turk
text_block_list.text:
...However.
You who recognize my judgment as sound
can also be called excellent trainer.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Slight feeling of being recognized
as guide for horse girls...
Brings ticklish feeling.
